title: Projection-normalized finite reduction comparison for integral pullback
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $R$ and uniformizer $t$, schemes $X,Y$ in the same universe as $E$, and $f:X\to Y$, with $\ell$ invertible on both schemes. Let $K\in D^b_c(Y,R)$, let $P$ be a flat-term K-flat complex, and let $e:QP\simeq K$ identify its localization with the underlying derived object of $K$. For $n\in\mathbf N$, define the isomorphism from the derived $R/t^{n+1}$-reduction of the prescribed completed $F_fK$ to the constant-coefficient derived pullback of the reduction of $K$ as follows. First take the scalar-extension adjunct of the actual nth projection of the defining integral Roos pullback tower, whose invertibility on this constructible input is given by preservation of constructibility. Then compose with the termwise finite pullback presentation comparison, the inverse exact-pullback localization comparison, and the finite pullback of the canonical reduction-of-representative isomorphism followed by reduction of $e$. This fixes the comparison for every good representative and every positive quotient exponent; it does not choose an arbitrary finite reduction isomorphism or assert a system-level naturality theorem.

def integralSystemPullbackReductionIso {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E Y)
    (P : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).FullSubcategory)
    (e : (DerivedCategory.Q (C := scalarReductionSource l E Y)).obj P.obj ≅ K.obj) (n : ℕ) :
    (scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E X n).obj
        ((constructibleIntegralPullback l E f).obj K).obj ≅
      (proEtaleConstantRingDerivedPullback (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1)) f).obj
        ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E Y n).obj K.obj)
